findings: Root and independent review found and corrected gaps in the new checker before final acceptance: result cardinality and exact call shape, NOINHERIT/SET ROLE membership, unexpected execute grantees and delegated service grants. The first new test collection had an incorrect relative import; after correction, 32/34 cases passed, with two fixture assertions using status instead of the preserved legacy state acknowledgment field. Only new test expectations were corrected. The expanded 41-case run passed, but independent review correctly rejected its administrator-session SET ROLE evidence as insufficient. Stronger source-session negative/positive controls then exposed fixture restoration failures in two 35/41 runs. Explicit restoration to the known disposable-fixture postgres identity, asserted alongside current/session identities, resolved those failures without weakening the permission tests. The final focused suite and independent rerun pass 41/41 with zero skips; scoped lint/types pass. All initial logs, the minimal restoration probe, corrections and reviews are retained. No prior application source, SQL, test, dependency, runner limit or application deadline was changed.
